description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for a git-cvsserver integration, specifically testing modes related to binary and text file handling, attribute usage, and repository synchronization scenarios.

methods.name: marked_as
methods.description: Checks if a file has a specific property (e.g., binary mode) by examining its CVS entries file and logs the result.

methods.name: not_present
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file is not present or marked as expected, logging errors if the file still exists.

methods.name: check_status_options
methods.description: Checks CVS status options, particularly sticky options, for a specific file in a directory.
